_doc: Policy-as-data for validate_docs_freshness.py. `required` lists the docs that must exist; `flags` tags docs with extra machine-checkable assertions (coverage_critical → re-verify the published TEST COVERAGE figure; score_ledger_authority → the score-ledger exclusion must be a positive, cross-referenced statement). Global checks (links, stale-phrase, tracked-path, canonical-commands) run over every tracked *.md regardless of this file.
